tables.name: import_jobs
tables.description: Tracks CSV import jobs and their status; used across legacy device import and patient import processors.

tables.name: patients_legacy_devices_import_rows
tables.description: Staging rows for legacy devices imported from CSV; used in import processor, import commit, and manual link functions.

tables.name: patients_import_rows
tables.description: Staging rows for patient data imported from CSV; used in the patient import processor and fix-modals.

tables.name: patients
tables.description: Main patient records; used for creating, updating, deleting, searching patients and linking inventory or prescription deliveries.

tables.name: inventory_items
tables.description: Holds inventory items (devices, accessories, etc.); used for creation, listing, status updates and linking to patients.

tables.name: trials
tables.description: Trial records for hearing aids; used to list and create trial entries.

tables.name: trial_devices
tables.description: Devices associated with a trial; used to manage trial device entries.

tables.name: profiles
tables.description: User profiles containing org_id and role; used to retrieve organization id for many operations.

tables.name: meeting_payments
tables.description: Payments linked to meetings; used to record meeting payments and manage installment plans.

tables.name: patient_installment_plans
tables.description: Installment plans for patient payments; used to manage and track patient installment plans.

tables.name: meetings
tables.description: Patient appointments; used for listing and creating meetings and linking payments/accessories.

tables.name: meeting_accessories
tables.description: Accessories sold during meetings; used to link accessories with specific meetings and patients.

tables.name: meeting_satisfaction_question_lists
tables.description: Templates for satisfaction surveys; used to manage question lists for meetings.

tables.name: meeting_satisfaction_questions
tables.description: Individual satisfaction survey questions; used when creating and editing survey templates.

tables.name: meeting_satisfaction_answers
tables.description: Patient responses to satisfaction surveys; stores answers collected from meetings.

tables.name: references
tables.description: Referral contacts; used to list, search and create reference entries.

tables.name: org_settings
tables.description: Organization-level settings (e.g. company name, preferences); used to load and update settings.

tables.name: device_catalog_models
tables.description: Device catalog model definitions; used in catalog import to create or update models.

tables.name: device_catalog_prices
tables.description: Device catalog pricing entries; used in catalog import for adding price rows.

tables.name: patient_sale_breakdown
tables.description: Line items for patient sales; used to track sale breakdowns per patient.

tables.name: battery_prescription_deliveries
tables.description: Records battery prescription deliveries with quantities and SGK expected amounts; used for tracking deliveries.

tables.name: device_repairs
tables.description: Device repair records; used to log repairs and update inventory item statuses.

tables.name: inventory_import_rows
tables.description: Staging rows for inventory CSV import; used during inventory import processing.

tables.name: reference_gifts
tables.description: Gifts and commissions given to reference contacts; used for listing, creating and updating reference gift records.

views.name: current_device_catalog_prices_public
views.description: View returning the latest device catalog prices for the current organization.

views.name: current_device_model_prices_public
views.description: View returning the latest device model prices for the current organization.

views.name: trial_devices_with_catalog_public
views.description: View combining trial devices with catalog details for easier queries.

views.name: patient_list_with_device
views.description: View listing patients with a summary of their current device.

views.name: patient_list_with_device_all
views.description: View listing all devices associated with patients, not just the current device.
